senses.en: the front part of the body below the chest; stomach

example.en: He lay on his back with his hands on his belly.
example.zh: 他仰面躺着，双手放在肚子上。

senses.en: the rounded front or underside of something

example.en: The belly of the plane opened to load cargo.
example.zh: 飞机的腹部打开以装载货物。

example.en: The sails bellied in the strong wind.

senses.en: to be unlike or not the same

example.en: The two paintings differ in color and style.
example.zh: 这两幅画在颜色和风格上不同。

senses.en: to disagree or have different opinions

example.en: The committee members differed over the budget.
example.zh: 委员会成员在预算问题上意见不一。

senses.en: the reflexive form of “we”, used when we are the object of our own action
senses.zh: 我们自己（we 的反身代词，表示动作回到自身）
我们本人；我们自己（用于强调）

example.zh: 我们亲眼看到了那场事故。

senses.en: The flesh of an animal eaten as food.

example.en: She cut the meat into thin slices.

senses.en: The most important or substantial part of something.
senses.zh: 某事物最重要或最实质的部分。

example.en: The meat of the report is in the final section.
example.zh: 报告的核心内容在最后一节。
